hero.subtitle: Master time. Conquer your projects
hero.description: Smart management for freelancers and teams. Visualize your progress, optimize your resources, and elevate your productivity to the next level.

plans.title: Boost your Productivity
plans.description: Just as Tikal wasn't built in a day, your productivity needs solid foundations. Choose the structure your project demands today.

free_plan.title: Individual Plan
free_plan.description: Everything you need to manage your tasks, track your time, and get into the zone without any cost.

premium_plan.title: Cooperative Plan
premium_plan.description: Unlock collaborative work, advanced reports, and role management to take your business to the next level.

plans.footer_note: Need both? No problem. The Builder plan includes your private personal space at no additional cost.

payment.title: Choose your payment method
payment.description: Select the billing frequency that best suits your workflow and budget.

monthly.title: Monthly payment
monthly.description: Keep full control of your expenses with our most flexible option. Ideal if you are just starting out, managing temporary projects, or simply prefer to evaluate the impact of the tool month by month. No long-term contracts: you have the freedom to cancel or change your plan whenever you need to.

quarterly.title: Quarterly payment
quarterly.description: The perfect balance between agility and commitment. Align your payments with your quarterly goals and reduce the administrative burden of monthly invoices, all while enjoying an exclusive discount for your medium-term trust.

annual.title: Annual payment
annual.description: The smartest financial decision for established teams. Make a single payment, forget about administrative renewals for 12 full months, and maximize your return on investment by taking advantage of our biggest available discount.

contact.title: We are here to listen to you
contact.description1: At Tikal, we believe that the best tool is the one that evolves with its users. Our commitment is twofold: to offer you agile and efficient technical support so that no obstacle slows down your workflow, and to maintain an open channel for collaboration.
contact.description2: Whether to resolve an urgent incident, guide you in using advanced features, or propose that improvement that would change your day-to-day, we are on the other side ready to listen to you. Your feedback is not only welcome, it is the blueprint on which we build the future of this platform.
